BiblicalUsage: Melqach is the tongs, the snuffers of gold that tended the temple lamps. 1 Kings 7:49 lists the tongs of gold among the vessels before the oracle, and 2 Chronicles 4:21 counts them again among the things made of perfect gold.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even the tongs were gold, because nothing that served the light was too small to be made well.
